Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 28 of 2021
Petitioner :- Akbar Ali

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vikrant Pandey,Prasoon Kumar
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1. None present for the petitioner to press this petition, even in the revised call.
2. Shri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent is present.

3.  This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 13.12.2020, registered at Case Crime No.0347 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 354, 506 IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Tanda, District Rampur.

4. By drawing attention to the short counter affidavit annexing therewith a copy of the charge-sheet,
learned A.G.A. submits that the charge-sheet no.31 of 2021 has been forwarded on 23.2.2023 in the present case, and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
5. In such view of matter, the present petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
